parameter_semantics: target_object, destination and handoff_object select red_pose, red_goal, blue_pose and blue_goal for causal relational conditioning. Learned translations are metres and rotations radians in the fresh measured TCP frame; arguments never provide actuator values or hidden phase.
output_semantics: Each slot is [translation x,y,z metres in the current measured TCP frame, relative TCP rotation vector x,y,z radians, native gripper scalar]. Labels use that slot's pre-action measured TCP; each execution decode composes the represented SE(3) transform with the fresh current TCP, then supplied IK converts the resulting world target from fresh qpos. Slot 0 is t-1 and slots 1..8 execute t..t+7. Gripper sign semantics are unchanged.

conversion_check.description: Compare FK of decoded IK against the demonstrated commanded TCP after exact pre-action TCP relative-pose log/exp roundtrip. Report position, rotation, gripper and IK diagnostics; no clipping or scripted correction is applied.

cut_relation: Binds every assigned action in all 12 full segments. The complete 230-240 action place_blue overlap receives fresh-TCP residual supervision for blue lower/open, retreat, transit, red approach/closure and initial lift before the remaining red placement.
